purpose: The fault population behind the cli-progress golden's expected level, measured outside the audit: every place the audit's operators (skill/agent-readiness/scripts/lib/mutate.ts allSites) can plant a fault in the files its tests import, each run against the suite (mocha 'test/**/*.test.js', the package's npm test) on Node 22.
expectation: With 1 of 11 sites caught, any draw of 5 holds at most 1 caught fault, which the 2026-12-beta estimate calls weak (at 5 faults, 0 or 1 caught is weak), so the faults condition is not met whichever faults are drawn. The frozen install from yarn.lock and the 6 tests pass in a clean node:22-bookworm container, so the component is Level 1.

stryker.note: Independent mutation tool, its own operators, run over every file in lib/: the suite kills 82 of 620 mutants (13%); 537 have no test covering them, since only lib/formatter.js and the files it requires are tested. On lib/formatter.js alone it kills 38 of 53 (72%), mostly string-literal mutants the audit's operators don't make.
